newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: RUGBY UNION-LOMU HAS NIGHTMARES OF BRIT WORLD CHAMPION.
newsitem.headline: RUGBY UNION-LOMU HAS NIGHTMARES OF BRIT WORLD CHAMPION.

text.p: Jonah Lomu's nightmare is seeing the All Blacks lose to the Springboks in Saturday's test match, and the British claiming world champion rugby status as a result.

"All we need is for the Brits to say 'we've beaten the Boks, the Boks have beaten the All Blacks, so now we're world champions'. We can't let that happen," the former All Black wing told reporters on Thursday.
"I hope the boys do well. They've got a great opportunity to set the record straight at Ellis Park," Lomu said, referring to New Zealand's loss to South Africa at the same venue last year.
Lomu, who reached superstar status during the 1995 World Cup, has been forced out of the game this year with a serious kidney disorder.
He finishes his treatment for the disease in three weeks and will have a series of tests before he knows whether he will ever be able to play rugby again.
"I'm feeling a lot better, and I've got a lot more energy. We find out in three weeks what the story is," Lomu said.
